integrity: Complete Plucker-coordinate proof and exact rational Groebner checks are included. Two of the three support lines are tangents, not proper secants; all multiplicities are Grassmannian local intersection lengths. No independent validation or publication-priority certification is claimed.
limitations: The intersection concerns closed secant congruences over C for a nonempty open subset of diagonal transformations. It does not classify exceptional diagonals, arbitrary twisted cubics, or real common secant distributions. Implicit coverage in older special degeneration literature remains possible.
title: The \(3+4+3\) common-secant cycle of diagonal twisted cubics
